subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw support a new same-session ContextEngine.maintain() invocation while a timed-out prior invocation remains in flight, or must the host preserve per-session plugin serialization after timeout?
rationale: The PR turns an implicit host invariant into a public plugin contract. Choosing liveness through re-entrancy versus preserving plugin serialization is a product and SDK compatibility decision that source-level fencing cannot settle.

options.title: Preserve plugin serialization
options.body: Keep at-most-one in-flight same-session maintain() call and design a bounded foreground handoff that does not require existing plugins to become re-entrant.

options.title: Adopt re-entrant maintenance
options.body: Approve concurrent same-session maintain() as a supported SDK contract and validate bundled and representative external engines against it.

recommendation.title: Preserve plugin serialization
recommendation.body: Keep at-most-one in-flight same-session maintain() call and design a bounded foreground handoff that does not require existing plugins to become re-entrant.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the closest evidence-backed contributor on the adjacent deferred-maintenance scheduler, though an explicit plugin-SDK owner should make the final decision.
